caption:
Mortgage lenders can now choose between scores. 🏠

Since April 2026, Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac loans can use VantageScore 4.0, not just Classic FICO.

Newer models look at about 24 months of habits, not just a snapshot.

Rules vary by lender, so ask which score yours uses.

Did you know there was more than one mortgage score?
first_comment: Did anyone here ever get told which score their lender pulled? 👇
